control.committeeTitle: Review committee: approval after the fraud review
control.footnote: Once approved by the committee, the award gets its number (AA-…) and enters the public registry. The artist is notified and the bonus is added to their balance, within the limits of the fund.
control.sanctions: Proven fraud: warning, revenue freeze, track removal; the award is withdrawn. Freezes and removals are decided by the founder.
control.rejectHelp: The reason is sent to the artist and logged.

thresholds.minArtists: Minimum number of different artists in a pack
thresholds.streamsPerSale: Equivalent streams per track sold (display only)
thresholds.qualifiedNote: An account or a phone counts once per track. Free plays and Short views are never counted.
thresholds.networkTrigger: Share of sales that triggers the rule (%)
thresholds.networkShare: Minimum share of the active network (%)
thresholds.activeDays: Active Asra Point: one sale in the last (days)
thresholds.tableNote: In qualified listeners, the same for every genre. Months counted from launch. Month 6 to 12 thresholds still to be confirmed.
thresholds.commitment: Reviewed twice a year, announced in advance. A track never loses a level it has already reached.

fund.title: Bonus fund
fund.rule: The fund is taken from AsraPa's share (35 %), never from the artists' share. Any unspent balance carries over to the next period.
fund.payoutsNote: Bonuses are paid in order of approval, within the limits of the fund. They are added to the artist's balance, paid quarterly from 30,000 FCFA.
fund.committee: Review committee (3 members, including 1 from the diaspora)
